baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا joins assigned state, lower ground, and inward gathering.
baseline_models.mechanism: جعل assigns the earth a state or function, while كفات supplies gathering, enclosure, and preservation. The rhetorical question presents containment as an already observable designed operation rather than a bare label.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state makes containment an assigned earth-function rather than a synonym for earth.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the physical substrate that receives the assigned function.
Gathering and holding close supplies the centripetal enclosure and preservation performed by the earth.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely calls the earth a receptacle.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts the earth as deliberately configured to gather, enclose, and keep what comes within it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كِفَاتًا can activate not only holding but turning back toward a direction, with earth as the named destination-field.
baseline_models.mechanism: The return branch of كفت changes bounded volume into directional action: the made earth diverts or reverses outward movement toward a terminus. Containment becomes repeated returnability rather than immobility.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state makes returnability a configured condition.
Lower ground supplies the concrete terminus toward which movement is redirected.
Turning back or being diverted aside supplies the homeward vector within the nominal predicate.

changed_reading.before: Earth is a static vessel that holds whatever is placed in it.
changed_reading.after: Earth is also a terminal field that bends outgoing trajectories back and repeatedly receives return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence moves from reproductive water through made stable placement to a bounded measure. Earth-as-kifat then reads as the larger continuation of the same designed holding process: a timed small enclosure is followed by the terrestrial enclosure into which its occupants emerge.

activation_trace.role: Gathering, enclosing, and preserving supplies the focus mechanism that can be rescaled.
Reproductive water in the womb supplies the initially enclosed human material.
The repeated making-into-a-state marks the first enclosure as deliberately configured, paralleling the focus.
Fixity and settling supply stable retention within the first enclosure.
A place of being turns stable retention into a located holding environment.
A measure that brings something to its bound adds a timed limit to containment.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 immediately precedes the focus and forms a creation, placement, and bounded-term sequence.
The first-person plural making frame in 77:21 recurs in نَجْعَلِ at 77:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reproductive water, repeated making, stable placement, place, and bounded measure; I infer a micro-to-macro analogy between the prior enclosure and earth. A live alternative is that they are adjacent proofs of design rather than one nested mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Earth is a generic large enclosure.
changed_reading.after: Earth is the macro-scale successor to measured gestational enclosure, continuing a designed sequence of human holding environments.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following antonymic pair specifies what the single holding function spans. Earth supports the living in an open domain and receives the dead into closed custody, so one medium performs two opposed modes of containment across the whole life-course.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies the shared physical medium for both occupant classes.
Gathering and holding close supplies the one function applied across contrary life states.
Living creatures supply the animate occupant class sustained by the earth.
Loss of force and life supplies the dead occupant class received and retained.

structural_cues: 77:26 directly follows the focus without a new finite verb, allowing أحياء وأمواتا to specify what كفاتا gathers.
The coordinated antonyms compress the full life-course into one earth relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies living beings, death, and gathering/holding; I assign the spatial asymmetry of life on exposed ground and death within it. A live alternative is that both classes are gathered without a surface/interior distinction.

changed_reading.after: Earth performs a double hold across life and death: habitable support for the living and close custody for the dead.

context_deltas.mechanism: Within the earth, repeated making installs fixed vertical masses while directed watering supplies potable flow. Kifat is therefore not closed storage but an internally differentiated holding system whose anchoring and provision make habitation possible.

activation_trace.role: Lower ground supplies the material domain whose internal organization is described next.
Enclosing and preserving supplies the habitat's integrating function.
Making something into a state extends deliberate configuration from the focus into the earth's interior.
Fixity and rooted stability supply the solid anchoring subsystem.
Mountain height supplies vertical differentiation within the containing earth.
Making water provision supplies active delivery from the earth-system to its inhabitants.
Sweet potable water makes the delivered flow sustaining rather than merely contained.

structural_cues: 77:27 resumes جعل and uses فيها, explicitly locating the listed structures and supply within the earth.
Fixed high features and water delivery are coordinated as complementary earth-functions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated making, fixed high features, administered water, and sweetness; I infer that these are subsystems by which earth performs kifat. A live alternative is that they are independent benefits listed after containment.

changed_reading.before: Kifat is a closed receptacle defined by capacity alone.
changed_reading.after: Kifat is open habitable infrastructure: a holding matrix organized by stable relief and circulating potable water.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier collapse sequence erases visible markers, opens the upper enclosure, and removes even solid elevated masses from place. Against that sequence, earth's holding state is designed but contingent: its present capacity belongs to an arrangement that can be undone.

activation_trace.role: Lower ground supplies the present stable domain whose permanence is put in question.
Holding and preservation supply the current function revised as temporary.
Erasure of trace supplies loss of the world's visible ordering marks.
A fissure opening between things supplies breach of an enclosing cosmic boundary.
Solid elevated aggregation supplies the strongest apparent fixture in the terrestrial order.
Uprooting and removal from place reverses that fixture and exposes the hold's contingency.

structural_cues: 77:8-10 forms a repeated إذا plus passive sequence of cosmic and terrestrial disassembly.
The focus later frames earth's present state as something made, which permits contrast with its unmaking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erasure, breached enclosure, solidity, and removal; I infer that the made holding-world is provisional. A live alternative is that only adjacent cosmic features change while earth's kifat function persists through transformation.

changed_reading.before: Earth's containing capacity appears permanent and natural.
changed_reading.after: Earth is a commissioned but time-limited holding arrangement whose stabilizing conditions can be withdrawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: Former and later cohorts follow one another into destruction, while the later gathering brings dispersed generations together for separation. Earth-as-kifat becomes temporal custody: it accumulates successive cohorts and has a release horizon at collective assembly and sorting.

activation_trace.role: Gathering, preserving, and taking in burial supplies the custody mechanism.
Separating things until their boundary appears supplies the terminal sorting horizon.
Falling into destruction supplies the recurrent entry of cohorts into death.
Beginning and precedence identify the earlier cohort in the accumulated sequence.
Successive following supplies the mechanism by which cohort is added after cohort.
Later status after the first identifies the subsequent cohort.
Joining the dispersed into one gathered whole supplies release from distributed custody into assembly.

structural_cues: 77:16-17 pairs first and later cohorts through ثم, making succession explicit.
77:38 combines the Day of Separation with gathering the audience and the former peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive cohorts, destruction, collective gathering, and separation; I infer earth as the interim custody layer connecting them. A live alternative is that final gathering is direct and does not conceptually pass through earth's hold.

changed_reading.before: Earth contains bodies one by one in undifferentiated space.
changed_reading.after: Earth keeps a time-layered deposit of successive generations until collective assembly and separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sends, sweeps, spreads, separates, and casts; the focus gathers, holds, and can turn movement back. Earth-as-kifat becomes the centripetal counter-phase of an outward kinetic sequence, receiving and arresting what has been dispersed.

activation_trace.role: Gathering and holding close supplies the inward pole opposed to dispersal.
Turning back or diversion supplies reversal from outward trajectory toward collection.
Dispatch and emission initiate motion away from a source.
A violent wind that lifts and scatters things intensifies outward displacement.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply spatial expansion.
Scattering into parts supplies loss of prior aggregation.
Casting something until it lands supplies the transition from outward release to reception.

structural_cues: 77:1-5 is an ordered participial sequence, with emphatic cognate verbal nouns in 77:2-4.
The later nominal كفاتا supplies a compact counter-image of collection after the opening expansion sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward dispatch, scattering, spreading, separation, casting, and focus-root inward/return images; I infer a kinetic polarity and cycle. A live alternative is that the opening agents have no material relation to the earth's containment.

changed_reading.before: The earth-container passively receives whatever happens to arrive.
changed_reading.after: Earth is the centripetal phase in a release, dispersal, and collection rhythm, actively arresting or reversing outward movement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the immediate syntax most directly makes living and dead the earth's contents, while this branch path reads them as states of earth itself. It remains anchored in the focus earth and turning branches, and context branches explicitly supply earth-life, dead land, and delivered water. Downstream prose should mark it as a secondary ecological activation, not replacement grammar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Earth's fertile-ground branch combines with كفات as turning or flipping, allowing containment to become cyclical material transformation.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies earth as a medium capable of entering a living state.
Turning back and flipping supplies reversible passage between opposed states.
Earth coming alive through rain and vegetation supplies one ecological state.
Dead land without life supplies the opposed ecological state.
Delivery by watering and pouring supplies the material driver of state reversal.

changed_reading.before: Earth holds two fixed classes, the living and the dead.
changed_reading.after: Earth itself turns between living and dead conditions under water, making kifat a recycling process as well as storage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines branch-distant material images of earth as a thick mat and كفت as tucking a garment or armor edge. It remains anchored in all three focus words and yields a coherent close-fitting enclosure. Downstream prose should present it only as a tactile analogy, never as the direct lexical sense of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The making construction links earth's thick-mat branch to كفات's image of gathered garment margins.

activation_trace.role: Making or fabricating supplies the construction of a tactile terrestrial covering.
The thick mat supplies earth as fabricated material rather than abstract space.
Gathering garment or armor edges supplies the close-fitting action by which the mat contains.

changed_reading.before: Earth is a floor or vessel beneath its occupants.
changed_reading.after: Earth can be imagined as a fabricated thick mat whose gathered margins fit closely around its occupants.

strongest_changes: 77:20-23 recasts earth as the macro-scale continuation of measured gestational enclosure.
77:26 specifies one holding function across living and dead, with a live surface/interior asymmetry.
77:27 turns containment into structured habitat through fixed elevations and potable water.
The succession and gathering sequence makes earth a temporal custody layer awaiting collective separation.
The opening dispersal sequence activates earth as a centripetal counter-movement rather than passive storage.
summary.what_was_special: The singleton ك ف ت inventory was unusually generative: gathering, return, garment, and motion branches let whole-surah cues transform a static receptacle into designed custody, habitat, counter-movement, and ecological cycling without severing the focus anchor.
remaining_uncertainties: The micro-to-macro relation with 77:20-23 may be nested mechanism or simply adjacent evidence of design.
The surface/interior distribution of living and dead is reader-supplied rather than explicitly spatialized in 77:26.
The opening dispersal and later gathering may form an intended kinetic polarity or only a productive whole-surah analogy.
The ecological phase-switch and gathered-mantle readings remain branch-distant and require explicit qualification.
